standard.coverage: ALL employers regardless of size. Minnesota's large-employer / small-employer split ENDED on 2025-01-01 -- a table still carrying two Minnesota rates is out of date.
standard.note: Minn. Stat. 177.24 annual inflation adjustment (capped at 5%).

tipped.note: This state allows NO tip credit: the full state minimum wage must be paid in cash before any tips. Minn. Stat. 177.24 subd. 2 -- Minnesota has never allowed a tip credit.

youthAndTraining.label: 90-day training wage
youthAndTraining.eligibility: Employees under 20, first 90 CONSECUTIVE days of employment -- Minn. Stat. 177.24 subd. 1(f). Also the figure Minnesota publishes for youth (under 18) and J-1 visa hotel/resort employees.
